svg.aria-label: Under the hood: one TypeScript monorepo and one Python engine. Browser, desktop app and phone use apps/app (Next.js, server actions, /api/v1), which talks to Postgres with row-level security and calls services/engine (Python, stateless, no database) with a signed, short-lived token. The engine reads and writes file storage (local disk, S3 or R2) through signed links that last five minutes at most. packages/core is the only place a date rule becomes a date. Other packages: contracts, db, ai, auth, storage, ui, tokens and i18n; ee/ holds the Business features under a commercial licence.

g.text: The only place a date rule becomes a date. Pure functions, no I/O.
